local out = {} for _, p in game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers() do local c = p.Character local r = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") table.insert(out, p.Name .. " char=" .. tostring(c ~= nil) .. (r and string.format(" @%.0f,%.0f,%.0f", r.Position.X, r.Position.Y, r.Position.Z) or "")) end return table.concat(out, " | ")
